gaps.explanation: Re-read pp6-7 (governmental funds statement, GAAP, Total revenues 6,960,328), schedule pp15-19, the budget-to-GAAP note p20 and nonmajor combining p21 / General Fund departments pp22-23. Each fund column has one schedule in detail; detail equals the printed schedule totals exactly (nothing missing, nothing doubled). Per fund, schedule vs statement column: General Fund departments 1,939,256 = 1,939,256; Street p15 801,945 vs 808,522 (-6,577); Airport p16 1,241,303 = 1,241,303; Infrastructure p17 730,611 vs 732,246 (-1,635); Economic Development p18 1,492,958 vs 1,493,635 (-677); Golf p19 689,932 = 689,932; nonmajor p21 55,434 = Other Governmental Funds 55,434. -6,577 - 1,635 - 677 = -8,889 = gap. The report itself prints these exact differences as 'Cash to accrual adjustments' on p20 (Note A: Street 6,577, Infrastructure 1,635, Economic Development 677). No line to add or remove.

Statement total expenditures 6,323,227 (p7). Per fund, schedule vs statement column: General Fund departments pp22-23 2,066,408 = 2,066,408; Street p15 total charges to appropriations 838,217 vs 802,763 (+35,454); Airport p16 807,489 (operating 570,034 + capital outlay 237,455) vs Airport column 1,803,216 (airport 609,680 + capital outlay 1,193,536) (-995,727); Infrastructure none / none; Economic Development p18 896,898 vs 859,200 (+37,698); Golf p19 757,706 vs 783,945 (-26,239); nonmajor p21 7,695 = 7,695. +35,454 - 995,727 + 37,698 - 26,239 = -948,814 = gap. The report prints each difference on p20 (Note A, Differences - budget to GAAP, cash to accrual adjustments: Street (35,454), Airport 995,727, Economic Development (37,698), Golf 26,239). The Airport difference is accrued capital outlay not paid in the budget year; the budget schedule's printed actuals are on the cash basis. Adding the Airport statement column would count the fund twice; the 995,727 is a printed reconciling adjustment, not a line. No line to add or remove.

Statement transfers in 544,939 = net by fund (p6 General 292,000 + Street 118,934; p7 Golf 134,005). Detail 756,667 = General Fund department transfers printed on pp22-23 (Administrative 360,703, Library 85,882, Park 57,143) + Street 118,934 (p15) + Golf 134,005 (p19). The department schedule prints Pool (211,728) separately; the statement General column nets it (360,703 + 85,882 + 57,143 - 211,728 = 292,000). 756,667 - 211,728 = 544,939. Gross vs net in the report; nothing to change.

Statement transfers out 809,175 = Infrastructure 804,175 + Other Governmental Funds 5,000 (p7). Detail 1,020,903 = those two (p17, p21) + General Fund Pool department (211,728) printed on p23, netted in the statement General column. 1,020,903 - 211,728 = 809,175. Nothing to change.
